newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Q4 unemployment rose to 7.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel Q4 unemployment rose to 7.3 pct.

text.p: Israel's Central Bureau of Statistics issued the following indicator on Monday.

The number of unemployed averaged 159,000 in the three months, up 8.4 percent from the final quarter of last year. The number of employed was 2.018 million, an increase of 2.1 percent from a year earlier.
The number of people in the civilian labour force was 2.177 million.

For all of 1996, the bureau said, joblessness had been rising at a rate of 2.5 percent per quarter since the second quarter. Nevertheless, average unemployment for the year was 6.7 percent, down from 6.9 percent in 1995.
It said the civilian labour force grew by 2.2 percent last year but that the labour force participation rate had fallen to 53.7 percent from 54.1 percent in 1995.
